title: 61 OFWs return from Saudi Arabia amid unrest

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sixty-one overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) affected by unrest in Saudi Arabia have returned safely to the Philippines, receiving financial assistance, temporary accommodation and transportation from the government upon their arrival, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said. The workers arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3 in Pasay City Sunday
